jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Polish OR Lituanian OR Czech - Multiple Shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

jobs.occupation: B Driver with progression to CE
jobs.description:
Do you want to become a truck driver and gradually work your way up to a CE driving licence? With our client, you will have the opportunity to learn the profession and develop your skills step by step.

As a B driver for this major logistics company, you will help ensure that food products are delivered safely and on time to customers every day. You will start by making deliveries with a van and receive guidance and training to obtain your CE driving licence.

- You drive a van as a B driver and make deliveries
- You learn the routes, customers and working methods
- You actively help with loading and unloading goods
- You check your load and ensure correct delivery
- You are in daily contact with customers and represent the company
- You follow training to progress to a CE driver position
- You accurately complete transport documents
- You work according to all safety and hygiene regulations

You will join a professional environment where you are guided step by step in your development. This is your opportunity to become a skilled truck driver with plenty of opportunities for further growth.

During the onboarding period, you will work in the warehouse in a two-shift system. If this period goes well, you will start the training and receive a contract with the company.
- Vaardigheden:
You are motivated to become a truck driver
You are open to a training programme towards obtaining your CE driving licence
You are responsible and calm in traffic
You are customer-friendly and communicate fluently
You work accurately and have a strong focus on safety

- Attesten:
You hold a valid B driving licence.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
/

- Vakkennis:
Previous experience as a driver is an advantage

- Talenkennis:
You speak and understand English well

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

 

The cream recipe:

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects 

Like Teddy, Business Analyst Business Intelligence at Cream, translate the BI needs of the business teams in specifications for the IT department, for both small demands or as part of larger projects (contributions or BI project). Your tasks will be

• Act as person of contact between Business Engineering Teams and the Development Team

• Define the business specifications for BI needs

• Participation in (or management of) BI projects, or on the BI tracks of other projects for the engineering activities (requirement definition, impact analysis, process definition), while representing the BI vision (and BI target architecture) that has been defined

• Collaboration with data delivery experts to deliver on projects

• Understand business requirements and build a functional analysis which covers needs of the business according to our BI reference architecture

• Collaborate with the development team

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master degree in Computer Sciences or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 2 years of experience in data and business analysis

• You have good knowledge in BI techniques and tools (BO, SAS, Cognos...)

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer oriented, and you have high communication skills and analytical skills

• You are polyvalent and can adapt easily to quickly changing environment

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English; a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

-

We connect the brightest minds in Europe to make industry greener, smarter and truly sustainable.

Jobomschrijving

Primary responsibilities project management support (50%):
	
• Creating timelines and contributing to effective planning of funded project activities.	
• Monitoring budgets of EU-funded projects and tracking team members’ time dedication consistently, systematically, and coherently.	
• Supporting team members in completing tasks, drafting, and submitting reports.	
• Oversee and implement the communication and dissemination tasks of projects.	
• Support organising conferences, events, meetings, and other activities linked to projects.	
• Providing communication support to Processes4Planet projects.

Communications activities and providing value to members (50%)
	
• Create a yearly Communication Plan and track its implementation,	
• Manage and enhance the Association’s external communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, etc.), 	
• Operate members-only collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint),	
• Manage internal communication with company members by operating the existing tools or suggesting new ideas.	
• Generate and write content for social media, news releases, newsletters, bulletins, etc.	
• Prepare presentations and small publications and manage relations with providers.	
• Support to facilitate networking activities 	
• Organise participation in external conferences, and support with organization of internal events (conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.).

Qualifications and experience:
	
• Degree in project management, communications, public relations, business administration or related studies.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in positions dealing with the tasks described for this position, with excellent performance.	
• Experience with EU funds is an asset.

Your key skills:
	
• An energetic person with a hands-on approach, task-oriented with attention to detail	
• Team player with a cooperative spirit	
• Ability to work in a small core team and diverse virtual teams with people across organizational boundaries and several countries/regions.
